comment: T3.50: verify the hero sprite is HIDDEN during the opening crash cinematic and only appears together with the crater at impact. Timeline: dev_command at t=1.0 starts cinematic; ship launches ~1.0s later; impact ~t=2.6; explosion ends ~t=4.4; cinematic finishes ~t=4.5. probe_hero_sprite reports sprite_visible + cinematic_playing. The key assertion: sprite_visible is false for the ENTIRE duration of the cinematic (t=1.0 to t=4.5), then becomes true afterward.
